title: Surprised by Attention: Predictable Query Dynamics for Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2603.12916v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multivariate time series anomalies often manifest as shifts in cross-channel dependencies rather than simple amplitude excursions. In autonomous driving, for instance, a steering command might be internally consistent but decouple from the resulting lateral acceleration. Residual-based detectors can miss such anomalies when flexible sequence models still reconstruct signals plausibly despite altered coordination. We introduce AxonAD, an unsupervised detector that treats multi-head attention query evolution as a short horizon predictable process. A gradient-updated reconstruction pathway is coupled with a history-only predictor that forecasts future query vectors from past context. This is trained via a masked predictor-target objective against an exponential moving average (EMA) target encoder. translated_title: 被注意力“惊讶”：面向时间序列异常检测的可预测查询动态
translated_abstract: 多变量时间序列异常通常表现为跨通道依赖关系的变化，而非简单的幅值偏移。例如，在自动驾驶场景中，转向指令本身可能是内部一致的，却与由此产生的横向加速度相脱节。基于残差的检测器可能会遗漏此类异常，因为灵活的序列模型即使在协调关系已发生改变的情况下仍能合理地重构信号。我们提出了AxonAD，一种无监督检测器，它将多头注意力的查询演化视为一个短视距的可预测过程。一个经梯度更新的重构路径与一个仅依赖历史信息的预测器相耦合，该预测器从过去的上下文预测未来的查询向量。模型通过针对指数移动平均（EMA）目标编码器的掩码预测器-目标目标函数进行训练。在推理阶段，重构误差与尾部聚合的查询失配分数相结合，该分数测量预（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出AxonAD无监督异常检测方法，将多头注意力查询演化建模为短视距可预测过程，通过仅依赖历史的预测器与EMA目标编码器进行掩码预测训练，在推理时融合重构误差与尾部聚合查询失配分数，从而捕捉传统残差检测方法易漏检的跨通道依赖关系异常。
en_tdlr: AxonAD is an unsupervised time series anomaly detector that treats multi-head attention query evolution as a short-horizon predictable process, training a history-only predictor against an EMA target encoder and combining reconstruction error with a tail-aggregated query mismatch score to catch cross-channel dependency anomalies that residual-based detectors miss.
